title: The Challenge for Leaders Today
session_title: Leading and Managing in Academia: A Perspective from Department Heads (Invited Talks)
abstract: When women are asked the key characteristics of leadership, they tend to cite confidence and determination, but less than half of them feel that they have these characteristics. The challenge for leaders, then, is to instill these characteristics in others through mentoring relationships, especially to young women in academia. Training the next generation of leaders takes time and personal engagement to teach young colleagues how to plan their career, negotiate and find strong role models. Beyond gender considerations, leaders will find that issues surrounding communication and trust will play critical roles in their effectiveness at promoting an inclusive environment.

topic: Building and Maintaining a Positive Culture in an Academic Department
title: Building and Maintaining a Positive Culture in an Academic Department
session_title: Leading and Managing in Academia: A Perspective from Department Heads (Invited Talks)
abstract: Developing a departmental culture may sound like the epitome of a fuzzy, non-engineering soft skill, but the long-term differences between organizations with positive and negative cultures can be astonishing. I will reflect on tactics for building a culture that is positive for faculty, staff and students in an academic engineering department. In this environment, it is important to be sensitive to the time pressures faced by people at every level in the organization and the competitive nature of academic research and success.
